description: GTFS Schedule is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Transport and Planning. The GTFS Schedule dataset contains static timetable information of public transport services in Victoria. The modes included are: All metropolitan and regional trains All metropolitan and regional buses (including coach) All metropolitan trams It is published in a standardised data format according to the GTFS specification. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Transport and Planning . Its tags are gtfs, levels, navigation, pathways, platforms. It offers 1 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
